name: Scenario
description: Represents a scenario on a worksheet.
remarks: A scenario is a group of input values (called _changing cells_) that's named and saved. The Scenario object is a member of the Scenarios collection. The Scenarios collection contains all the defined scenarios for a worksheet.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ChangingCells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the changing cells for a scenario. Read-only.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the comment associated with the scenario.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the scenario is hidden.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the object is locked.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Returns a Variant array that contains the current values of the changing cells for the scenario.

methods.name: ChangeScenario
methods.signature: ChangeScenario(ChangingCells As Variant, [Values As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Changes the scenario to have a new set of changing cells and (optionally) scenario values.

parameters.name: ChangingCells
parameters.description: A Range object that specifies the new set of changing cells for the scenario. The changing cells must be on the same sheet as the scenario.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: An array that contains the new scenario values for the changing cells. If this argument is omitted, the scenario values are assumed to be the current values in the changing cells.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Shows the scenario by inserting its values on the worksheet. The affected cells are the changing cells of the scenario.
